_comment: One entry per pass. `source` is a file in this directory: a .gpx recorded
on the road, or a .json response from the Overpass API for its OSM way.
Only tracks whose source file exists need to be listed — anything absent
keeps its authored stand-in, so this can be filled in one road at a time.
width and surface are optional overrides. Leave them out and OSM tags are
used when present, falling back to a 6m mountain road on coarse asphalt.
segment_names is optional and positional; unnamed corners are named after
what they turned out to be.

tracks.name: Mt. Akina — Downhill
tracks.flavour: Five consecutive hairpins. The gutter is a line, if you're mad enough.
tracks.real_world: Mt. Haruna, Gunma — the east-face descent from Lake Haruna towards Takasaki.

tracks.name: Irohazaka — One Way Down
tracks.flavour: Forty-eight corners, all numbered, all going the same direction. Down.
tracks.real_world: Iroha-zaka, Nikko, Tochigi — the descending one-way road.
